value.stringValue: Read the entire Product Guide by the end of Week 1.

Record yourself on Zoom presenting the Sales deck (Link 1). Go slide-by-slide stating the purpose, why it matters, and how it solves dealer problems. Graded on clarity, confidence, accuracy, and mastery of content. Max time: 30 min.

Record yourself on Zoom presenting the Launch deck for a new store. For each slide: cover the goal, timeline impact, dealer expectations, reporting touchpoints, and post-launch support. Graded on process mastery. Max time: 30 min.
RAD reviews the Sales Presentation deck and videos (see Resources Link 1 for deck). Focus: how to position our platform, prove value, and handle objections with dealers.
RAD reviews the Launch deck (see Resources Link 2) and video. Be prepared to present.

Overview of Apollo, our Customer Experience Platform (CXP). How the platform connects websites, ads, retention, and reporting so dealers can sell, service, and keep more customers with one connected, end-to-end experience.

CTL gives a high-level tour of Apollo. Briefly hits each category and subcategory on the dashboard: where data comes from, how budgets are set, where results live, and how RADs use that info with dealers

Record yourself on Zoom walking through PreQual. Show how a shopper gets pre-qualified, sees real payments, and turns into a high-intent lead. Then show where reporting lives and how you would explain ROI to the dealer.

Record yourself on Zoom walking through Assistant/Text. Show how it captures sales and service opportunities and routes them to the store. For each workflow, explain what it does, why it matters to the dealer, and how you report on it.

Record yourself on Zoom walking through Vehicle Detail Videos (VDVs). Show how pricing, offers, payments, photos, and calls-to-action drive conversion. Then show where reporting lives and how you would attach an ROI.

CTL reviews Profiles: how shopper-specific profiles work on the site, how they pull in offers, service history, and trade value info, and how RADs explain this to dealers as a retention and loyalty feature.

CTL reviews Website Assistant / Text: how we capture leads and service requests through workflows, how responses route to the store, and how to position this as fast, low-effort engagement for the dealer.
CTL reviews Prequal: how soft-pull / prequalification works on the site, how payments update using real credit info, and how this creates finance-ready leads.

CTL reviews Transact: building a deal online, valuing the trade, calculating payments with consistency, adding aftermarket products, & booking appointments. Focus is on setting dealer expectations for lead quality and next steps.

CTL reviews Vehicle Detail Views (VDVs): what appears on a VDV page, how incentives and payments are generated automatically, and how it drives conversion. RAD should know how to compare our VDV experience vs competitors.

CTL ties each website product to reporting: Profiles, Assistant/Text, PreQual, Transact, and VDVs. Show where metrics live (traffic, chats/leads, logins, engagement rate, ROI) and how RADs use trends to prove value and fix gaps.
RAD selects one dealership and recommends Sales + Service THC using data. Present targeting, cadence, budget, creative themes, and expected outcomes. Built on this week’s THC training videos.
CTL reviews Comms Manager definitions, targeting and cadence, and creative best practices. Reviews Email & Mail reports. Defines desired KPIs: deliverability, opens, CTR, conversions,& unsubscribes.
CTL reviews CallRevu integration: navigate dashboards, trends, and recordings; show increases/declines & answered vs. missed.
CTL gets the RAD invited to as many new-client onboarding calls as possible to observe.
Complete all Google Skillshop Training Modules below and post your certifications to DRIVE, then post link to the right:
Manage GA Data and Learn to Read Reports

Pick a dealer. In Apollo, walk through each active campaign (brand, new/used, service, VLA/video). State purpose, the searches it targets, and KPIs to watch (IS, CTR, CPC, CVR, conversions/calls). Call out wins/risks and 2–3 fixes.

Pick a 2nd dealer. In Apollo, walk through each active campaign (brand, new/used, service, VLA/video). State purpose, the searches it targets, and KPIs to watch (IS, CTR, CPC, CVR, conversions/calls). Call out wins/risks and 2–3 fixes.

CTL reviews Apollo ad reporting: campaign types, benchmarks, budgets, and trends. Quick tour of Google Ads: locations, keywords/search terms, impression share, conversions. RAD learns how to turn results into clear dealer takeaways.
CTL trains RADs to hunt concerns in the data: where to look, how to read trends, and bring three fixes. We don’t enter meetings “green”—we poke holes and recommend tweaks to improve results.
CTL teaches the customer journey report: deployment dates, channels touched, and final sale/service transactions to show true ROI. RAD learns to connect interactions to outcomes and tell the story.
Core Website Vitals (see link 1 for article)

RAD brings together all trainings: incorporate Monthly Reporting Deck, digad reporting, mail, email, website engagements, transactions, market insights. Must be a dealer that is investing in full CXP.
RAD reviews Market Insights aka “Urban Science” video and learns how to pull insights and use them in reporting meetings to guide strategy. CTL provides RAD with access
CTL walks RAD through updates/news, and opportunities/solutions slides. RAD must know these decks are presented to 100% of dealers monthly, in full.
CTL trains RAD on NCM; grants access.
CTL performs and records a Reporting Meeting simulation.
